specifications.name: Stored furnishings have no active effect
preconditions: Authorized disposable character; stored furnishings with nonzero aura
Mog House installed layout is assumed empty; not independently observed
cleanup: Read-only GM diagnostic; client session must disconnect
Do not claim installed-layout agreement or held-key-item equivalence
specifications.purpose: Verify that furnishings stored in Mog Safe do not grant an active Moghancement when no furniture is installed.
specifications.rationale: Owning an aura-bearing furnishing should not activate an effect unless its installation state meets the DSP oracle; this protects against storage/placement state confusion.

given: An authorized disposable test character is connected in-zone
Mog Safe contains at least one furnishing with a nonzero aura
Installed furniture layout is assumed empty; independent layout readback is unavailable
when: The runner observes the character, Safe contents, active Moghancement diagnostic, and persisted inventory
then: Active Moghancement key item equals the source-backed empty-layout expectation
All eight elemental aura values are zero
Observed bag and Mog Safe rows match persisted rows after the save boundary

steps.title: Confirm the intended character is connected
steps.expected: Connected in-zone character ID equals approved_charid
steps.confidence_note: Approved character ID is runner-reported provenance, not independent operator approval.

steps.title: Confirm aura-bearing furnishings are stored
steps.expected: Stored furnishings collection contains at least one aura-bearing item
steps.confidence_note: This checks storage, not installed furniture.

steps.title: Observe active Moghancement with the layout assumed empty
steps.expected: Observed active Moghancement key item equals the empty-layout oracle
steps.confidence_note: Installed layout is NOT independently observed; do not infer it from this PASS.

steps.title: Verify all elemental aura values are zero
steps.expected: Eight observed aura values are zero
steps.confidence_note: GM diagnostic observation imported from an earlier runner report.

steps.title: Compare client bag with persisted inventory
steps.expected: Full client bag rows match authoritative persisted bag rows
steps.confidence_note: Both sides were imported from one runner report; independent authentication and completeness must be assessed.

steps.title: Compare client Mog Safe with persisted inventory
steps.expected: Full client Mog Safe rows match authoritative persisted Safe rows
steps.confidence_note: Both sides were imported from one runner report; independent authentication and completeness must be assessed.

blocking_gaps: Installed furniture layout not independently read back
Client held key items not independently compared with persisted keyitems
Inventory server snapshot completeness not independently proven

specifications.name: Inventory client versus persisted DSP
preconditions: Capture save boundary and full inventory container mapping
cleanup: Reject truncated server snapshots as incomplete
